payout_quote: Redeem your rewards as you earn, for cash via PayPal, gift cards, or cryptocurrency via BitPay. Cash out starting at only $1.00. Get a $5 bonus when you earn at least $10 within 30 days of registration. (official Lootup homepage)
timing: Official page claims 'instant rewards for completing tasks'; no payout-processing schedule published.
biggest_catch: Cash-out starts at just $1, but per-survey/offer earnings are small and variable, so the effective hourly rate is low — this is variable microtask earnings, never guaranteed income.
steps: Complete surveys, offers, games, videos, cashback shopping, loot-chest opens, contests, or giveaways.
Cash out starting at $1.00 via PayPal, gift cards, or BitPay crypto.
Optional: earn a $5 bonus by earning at least $10 within 30 days of registration.

The $5 bonus requires earning at least $10 within 30 days of registration (official).
Payout processing time is not stated officially.
